blocks.title: Jiddat
blocks.text: Jiddat aise naye khayalat, products ya tareeqe banana hai jo numayan tabdeeli ya behtari layein. Yeh sirf bilkul nayi cheez ijad karna nahi balke maujooda cheezon ko behtar, tez ya zyada kaarkard banana bhi hai.

Pakistan mein mobile banking misal hai: jinhein pehle bank jana parta tha, jo dehi ilaqon walon ke liye aksar mushkil tha, ab phone se paisa bhejte aur lete, bill ada karte aur accounts sambhalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Karobar mein jiddat bunyadi taur par kis cheez ke baare mein hai (MCQ 10)?
blocks.explanation: (b) maujooda products aur tareeqon ko behtar banana, aur naye banana bhi; chapter zor deta hai ke jiddat sirf nayi technology ijad karna nahi.

items: Jiddat: naye ya behtar products aur tareeqe (mobile banking).
